continuity_policy: Give every recurring character a stable character_id and versioned reference sheet before producing their recurring appearances.
Attach the relevant saved reference image to every subsequent generation; repeat face, hair, age, proportions and identifying wardrobe/accessories in the prompt.
Compare the result with its reference, especially face, hair, beard, skin tone, outfit, accessory placement and apparent age. Regeneration can drift; do not assume consistency from text alone.
Keep each scene's language content, role and action within the jointly reviewed lesson stage; never embed lesson answers or technical UI information into narrative images.
Introduce or change a character identity through a small joint review; version references and keep earlier assets recoverable.
Use one stable voice per character after the separate joint voice audition; a chosen image does not approve a voice.
version_policy: Keep approved v1 unchanged; save requested appearance changes as a new version and review them before replacing the canonical reference
